objective: 完成 Container Runtime V2 的 evidence-only Graph seam：复用已购买的 immutable snapshot/reducer，增加纯 derived relation assessment 和鲜证据优先验证，不创建 stateful Graph service 或第二套接口

semantic_brief.summary: Buyer：r5 expected/observed mismatch、Z4 contamination 与 multi-entry 压力要求历史 Graph 只能是 evidence prior。复用已购买的 snapshot/reducer，增加纯查询和 derived assessment，不为接口形式新建并行 abstraction。
core_points: 同 Source/affordance 的更新鲜 completed occurrence 到不同 Destination 时只 challenge 历史 prior
Graph query 不提供 route、next action、authorization、return synthesis、recovery 或 completion
异常或 NOT_ELIGIBLE occurrence 可读但不会因为查询而晋升 normal relation

change_principles: 实现前再次搜索 Graph/read/record/store abstraction，并在结果中列出 REUSE/EXTEND/REFACTOR/CREATE 裁决
复用现有 V2 production/test 文件；除非现有职责无法承载，否则不得新增文件、interface、service 或 mutable owner
derived relation assessment 只能读取 immutable state；不得写回 Graph、缓存 latest、增加 maturity FSM 或把 assessment 当 world/action truth
fresh-conflict 判定必须至少绑定同 Source、同 opaque entry-affordance evidence、completed occurrence、更新 revision 和不同 Destination；缺少关联证据时不得猜 conflict
原始 supporting/conflicting occurrences 必须保持 independently readable；不重写历史 relation 或 occurrence
Graph 中已有 relation 不得阻止 fresh CurrentContainer 指向 observed destination
你不是仓库唯一执行者；不得回退或覆盖他人/用户修改，发现 scope 文件并发变化则停止上报 Leader
acceptance: WorkResult 明确证明没有现成同职责 Graph service，并给出 REUSE snapshot/reducer 而不创建 IContainerGraphReader/IContainerGraphRecorder 的裁决；若结论不同必须先 BLOCKED 返回 Leader
新增最小 immutable derived assessment value 和 static pure query/projection，所有 public API 有准确 XML doc 与 NEW_SYMBOL_JUSTIFICATION
测试证明 Desktop/Search 到同 Settings 保持两 relation、不同 occurrence 支持同 relation、相同 trigger text/ref 不决定 RelationRef
测试证明历史 A relation 与同 Source/affordance 的更新 fresh B occurrence并存，CurrentContainer=B，历史 relation保留且 derived assessment被 challenge；缺少同 affordance或未完成 occurrence不 challenge
测试证明 off-path/transient NOT_ELIGIBLE occurrence 可读、normal relation不增加、query零 mutation
架构 Guard 证明新 query/projection为static pure且无 route/action/authorize/recover/complete/current-mutation/provider/task/callback surface
targeted tests、Runtime Rebuild、git diff --check通过；Rebuild单独报告新文件warning与既有warning
forbidden: 禁止修改 OpenSpec、docs、WorkItem、tasks checkbox或 scope.write 之外任何文件
禁止新增 IContainerGraphReader、IContainerGraphRecorder、ContainerGraphStore、ContainerGraphService 或任何 stateful Graph owner
禁止把 historical relation 变成 route/action/return/current/completion authority
禁止新增 relation maturity FSM、canonical parent、reverse-edge return、cross-Run persistence、planner 或 checkpoint state
禁止用 trigger display text、semantic identity、bounds、ordinal 或 StableKey 合并 relation/node
禁止放宽现有 fail-closed 或删除测试取得 GREEN
escalation: 若 derived conflict 需要 Action expectation 或 Agent obligation 才能安全判断，保留缺失状态并返回 BLOCKED_FOR_NEXT_WORKITEM，不读取或修改 Agent
若 snapshot/reducer 无法满足 read/record seam 且确需新 interface/service，先返回 REUSE/EXTEND/REFACTOR/CREATE 比较和真实 consumer/test buyer，不自行创建
若需要把 assessment 持久化为 mutable truth 或改变 Runtime authority，返回 REQUIRED_HUMAN_GATE
若 scope 文件存在不明并发修改或失败指向 scope 外，保留现场并返回 Expected/Observed/Gap/FirstDivergence/Owner
